assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis is coded I25.10 and I34.0.
The Holter monitor is coded CPT 93226.
The monitor is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms.
The monitor is ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular pathology.
The service was denied under Reason Code CO-50.
The denial was based on the medical necessity requirements not being met.
The clinical indication directly documents the symptoms and the hemodynamic assessment the monitor is designed to address.
